mapper.select: WITH MONTHLY AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ORDERED_AT, 'YYYYMM') AS YM, TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE STATUS = '90' UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(ORD_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YM, TOT_AMT FROM TB_ORD_H_ARCH ) SELECT M.YM AS ym, SUM(M.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS salesAmt FROM MONTHLY M GROUP BY M.YM ORDER BY ym

WITH STAT_CD AS ( SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'ORD_STAT' ) SELECT S.CODE_NAME AS statNm, COUNT(H.ORDER_ID) AS cnt FROM STAT_CD S LEFT JOIN ORDERS H ON H.STATUS = S.CODE GROUP BY S.CODE_NAME
